name: ice_zone
description: Geury's exposed-ice zones at the Milankovic scarps, measured from HiRISE enhanced color (ESP_071006_2345) by selecting pixels bluer than red/green, grouped into bands; about +/-15 m. Rebuilt from the bounds in Geury's site pack (rectangles), not his original traced shapes. Blue tone is consistent with ice, not proof; see docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md section 2.
source: Geury, Terps To Mars site and data pack, 2026-11-14; image NASA/JPL-Caltech/UArizona

properties.name: Main band
properties.note: North-facing (pole-facing) scarp; high plain to the south, depression floor to the north
